divisions.title: Laboratory Analytical Services
divisions.register_label: LABORATORY FIELD WORK · LABORATORY BENCHTOP ANALYSIS
divisions.summary: In-situ field measurements and benchtop analysis of water, sediment, soil and biota at KMFRI laboratories.
divisions.highlight: KMFRI runs a national network of marine and freshwater laboratories that test water quality, fish safety and freshness, feed nutrition, microbiology, heavy metals, microplastics and radioactivity. Choose single parameters at published per-test rates, or send a full sample list for a combined quotation. The same scientists who monitor Kenya’s oceans and lakes analyse your samples.
divisions.tagline: Know exactly what is in your water, fish, feed and sediment.
benefits: Published per-test tariffs — pay only for the parameters you need
Field (in-situ) and benchtop analysis from one provider
Results backed by KMFRI’s marine and freshwater scientists
Apply online through eCitizen and track your request

children.title: Field Work — In-situ Measurement
children.summary: Parameters measured on site with field probes and meters.
children.highlight: KMFRI teams measure key water parameters directly at your pond, dam, river, creek or outfall, so the readings reflect real conditions without transport delays. Ideal for routine farm checks, environmental baselines and compliance monitoring.

items.blurb: Oxygen available to fish and aquatic life, measured at the sampling point.

items.name: Transparency / turbidity in water
items.blurb: Water clarity — indicates plankton, sediment load and pond productivity.

items.name: Conductivity in water
items.blurb: Dissolved-salt indicator; a quick check for pollution or salinity change.

items.name: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) in water
items.blurb: Dissolved minerals measured in the field with a calibrated probe.

items.blurb: Field estimate of algal biomass and bloom risk.

children.title: Benchtop Analysis — Water
children.summary: Water chemistry, nutrients and organic load measured in the laboratory.
children.highlight: Full laboratory water chemistry for fish farms, hatcheries, water utilities, industries and environmental consultants — from alkalinity and hardness to nutrients (nitrogen and phosphorus) and organic load (BOD, COD). Use it to manage pond productivity, prove effluent compliance or investigate pollution.

divisions.title: Aquaculture & Mariculture Products
divisions.summary: Fingerlings, broodstock, ornamental fish and fish feeds from KMFRI hatcheries.
divisions.highlight: Start, restock or scale up your fish farm with seed produced by Kenya’s aquaculture research institute. KMFRI hatcheries supply mixed-sex and all-male (monosex) tilapia, African catfish, broodstock for your own hatchery, ornamental fish for aquariums and ponds, and formulated feeds for every growth stage. Most products can be ordered online today.
divisions.tagline: Quality fish seed, broodstock, feeds and ornamental fish from KMFRI hatcheries.

divisions.title: Research Vessels & Diving
divisions.summary: Charter of KMFRI research vessels and hire of scientific diving equipment.
divisions.highlight: KMFRI operates Kenya’s national research fleet, led by the oceanographic vessel RV Mtafiti, with RV Uvumbuzi and smaller boats for coastal and inland work. Charter a vessel for research cruises, fisheries and environmental surveys, cable and pipeline routes or training at sea, and hire scientific diving equipment for reef and underwater work.
